subject: Pilot closeout: throughput & unit-cost results + quick reference ask
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@luminate.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot closeout: throughput & unit-cost results + quick reference ask

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week pilot. We ran the recommended config (gptx-std + quantized KV cache) against your peak routing workload and wanted to share the high-level outcomes before the final closeout. Short summary below — full report attached.

Key results (end-to-end, measured on your dev workload):
- Average token throughput: 2.7x improvement vs your baseline cluster (from ~120 reqs/s to ~330 reqs/s on identical query mix).
- Median latency: 95 ms (baseline 280 ms). P95: 185 ms.
- Cost per 1M tokens (inference only): reduced by ~42% (projected at scale with batching + prefix cache).
- Cache hit rate (prefix KV cache): 63% for repetitive session patterns, which drove most of the unit-cost improvement.
- No functional regressions observed across the test prompt set; hallucination rate in our eval set held steady at ~1.1%.

Attachments: luminate_pilot_report.pdf (detailed breakdown) and luminate_token_costs.csv (raw numbers).

Request: would Luminate be open to a short public-facing one-line endorsement we can use in a post-pilot case brief? Example we can propose: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~40% while improving latency — immediate win for productionizing LLM features." If that works, we can draft a few variations and send for your sign-off.

Optional: if you have 10 minutes for a quick call next week we can capture a 20–30s audio quote (phone or recorded Zoom) and confirm any redaction needs for the numbers. Marissa will coordinate scheduling.

If you prefer we can anonymize the numbers in the public brief and only use a qualitative line. Either option works for us — just let us know what you're comfortable with.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Advocate | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

[Attachment: luminate_pilot_report.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: luminate_token_costs.csv (csv)]

Subject: Re: Pilot closeout: throughput & unit-cost results + quick reference ask

Hi Sofia —

Great to see the numbers — thanks for the clear recap and for the report. The throughput and latency wins track with what our internal SREs observed during the load window. The cost reduction is also a big deal for our roadmap economics.

Happy to provide a short endorsement. Two quick asks before public-facing use:
1) Please anonymize any customer-identifying timeline (e.g., do not state the pilot dates).
2) Keep the numbers rounded (we prefer "~40%" rather than 42%).

Proposed one-liner we can approve now: "Redwood delivered ~40% inference cost savings while improving latency — a clear production win." If you want a 20–30s audio snippet, I'm available for a quick recording on Mon 6/26 or Tue 6/27 (PST).

Regards,
Jessica Park
Director, Platform Engineering | Luminate Analytics
jessica@luminate.ai

Quick plan:

- If you can spare 10 minutes on Mon 6/26 at 10:00am PST, we can record a quick 20–30s soundbite over Zoom and capture verbal permission for the quote. If that time doesn't work, here's a Calendly link to pick an alternate: https://calendly.com/marissa/10min.
- We'll flag any sensitive sections of the report (numbers or configuration details) for redaction — we won't publish anything without explicit sign-off.

Thanks again — Mateo, looping you in for any technical clarifications during the call.

Best,
